melody.name: Autumn Leaves
melody.lyrics: The falling leaves drift by the window. The autumn leaves of red and gold. I see your lips, the summer kisses, the sunburned hands I used to hold. Since you went away, the days grow long And soon I'll hear, old winter’s song But I miss you most of all, my darling When autumn leaves, start to fall.
